title: Aspect Ratio Calculator
h1: Aspect Ratio Calculator — Resize Width and Height
description: Calculate a missing width or height from an aspect ratio, or simplify pixel dimensions to a ratio. Handy for images, video and CSS. Private in-browser math.
intro: Enter a width and height to simplify the ratio, or lock a ratio and solve for the missing side. Useful for crops, embeds and responsive layouts.
blurb: Solve width, height and simplified aspect ratios without breaking proportions.
howItWorks: Enter pixel width and height, then press Simplify ratio to reduce them by their greatest common divisor.
To resize, set the target ratio and one side, then press Height from width or Width from height.
The decimal form is width divided by height, which CSS uses as the aspect-ratio value.
examples: A 16:9 frame that is 1280 wide is 720 high.

faq.a: Both sides are divided by their greatest common divisor, so 1920:1080 becomes 16:9. The visual proportion does not change.

faq.q: Can I use this for video crops?
faq.a: Yes. 16:9 is common for widescreen video, 9:16 for vertical stories, 4:5 for portrait posts and 1:1 for square crops.
